verdict.rationale: LanceDB supports bulk operations such as batch deletes/updates via SQL-like predicates, multi-vector batch search with query_index mapping, incremental reindexing/optimize() across full tables, and bulk embedding pipelines via UDFs/embedding registry, all documented as first-class operations across many rows at once. missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks of bulk throughput at scale, and no explicit bulk-insert/bulk-upsert API documentation beyond delete/update examples.
